question:
**In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

Scientists have determined that the human tongue is attuned to several (1)_____ like sweet, salty, bitter, sour, savoury and possibly fat. Telling the difference between these tastes was crucial for human (2)______.
solution:
The correct answer is **"flavours; existence". **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is discussing the different tastes that the human tongue can detect.
 
• The word **"attuned" **means sensitive or responsive to.
 
• In the context of the passage, the word "**flavours**" is the most appropriate choice to fill the blank as it refers to the various tastes that the human tongue can detect, such as sweet, salty, bitter, sour, savoury, and possibly fat.
 
• The word "**existence**" is the correct choice to fill the second blank. The passage is discussing the significance of the human ability to differentiate between various tastes or flavors. 
 
• The ability to distinguish between these tastes was important for human survival.
 
• The word **"existence"** in option 4 accurately conveys this idea.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"season; reality",** does not make sense in the context of the passage.
 
• **"relish; live",** is not a suitable replacement for the missing word.
 
• **"tang; alive"**, is not accurate as a description of the senses of taste.
